source_filter: exact two-message prompt: invariant generic developer text plus one user message; omit only that invariant developer text and use C25 Instruction/Response template
pair_filter: both full responses+prompt+EOS fit128; world non-tie votes >=8 and majority fraction >=0.60
identity: model-generated CoVal responses, real human world-view vote majority; no annotator IDs/demographics/rationales copied
test_policy: DPO training reads train/validation only; this subset is highly selected and cannot represent all CoVal or user aesthetics
